name: report-pdf-fit-boundary
goal: A full-width 900px screenshot fits a single PDF evidence page without a one-pixel continuation, preserving all image pixels and tall-image pagination

evidence: Planned feature specifies one evidence page per fitted 1440x900/1600x900 capture, complete source rows, preserved tall-image pagination, immutable original reports and visual export inspection.

Unchanged pdf-screenshot-visibility suite fails only the 1440x900 fitted case: expected three image-bearing pages (cover/before/after), observed five due to 899px plus 1px crops. 1600x900 fitting and tall-image source-row preservation cases pass. Genuine latest-stage PDF continuation page inspected as blank.

Use the complete source height when the selected scale already fits the image. Retain source tiling only for genuinely tall images rendered above the fit scale; no epsilon workaround or screenshot edits.

The same three screenshot visibility/source-row tests pass unchanged after the one-line fix; all seven PDF/export/JPEG preservation regressions pass. Tall-image pagination and original JPEG bytes remain covered.

Full Harness bun run check passes: format/types/lint, 175 units (25 existing live opt-in skips), 49 CLI E2Es, build, packaging, root audit and 86 report tests plus report type/lint/build/audit. Isolated original-code challenge rejects [900,899,1,899,1] and the repair accepts [900,900,900], with owned temp cleanup. Regenerated real staging evidence PDFs inspected at readable resolution: 21 pages for issue 1182 and 38 for issue 986, no one-pixel image objects or blank continuation, exact original assets retained; both ZIPs below 25 MiB.
